description: In front of you is an open brown shelf unit beside a gray toy oven, with several clear plastic food containers and one small green-lidded container on the table. The left hand repeatedly picks up small clear containers from the tabletop and places them into the middle shelf, stacking them on top of each other, then slides a larger rectangular clear container into the lower shelf and finally nests the green-lidded container inside that larger one; the right hand stays mostly to the side, briefly hovering near the large container but not holding it.
